3.translation: Redução de Cura, Castigador de Almas

6.source: '''Old Kai''' (the Elder Kai) is a [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|master]] who lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Old Kai's Pillar|Old Kai's Pillar]] on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sacred Kai Planet|Sacred Kai Planet]]. He is tied to unlocking your hidden potential: besides a few skills and the Soul Punisher, he runs the '''Ultimate Challenge''', which unlocks the [[Special:MyLanguage/Ultimate|Ultimate]] form and gives you the [[Special:MyLanguage/Z Sword|Z Sword]]. He only trains Good-aligned players.
6.translation: O '''Velho Kaioshin''' (o Kaioshin ancião) é um [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|mestre]] que mora no [[Special:MyLanguage/Old Kai's Pillar|Pilar do Velho Kaioshin]], no [[Special:MyLanguage/Sacred Kai Planet|Mundo Sagrado dos Kai]]. Ele está ligado a liberar seu potencial oculto: além de algumas habilidades e do Castigador de Almas, ele comanda o '''Desafio Ultimate''', que desbloqueia a forma [[Special:MyLanguage/Ultimate|Ultimate]] e dá a você a [[Special:MyLanguage/Z Sword|Espada Z]]. Ele só treina jogadores de índole Boa.

8.source: Old Kai lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Old Kai's Pillar|Old Kai's Pillar]] in the Sacred Kai Plains. The Sacred Kai Planet is reached by [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]] once you complete [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] quest 23.
8.translation: O Velho Kaioshin mora no [[Special:MyLanguage/Old Kai's Pillar|Pilar do Velho Kaioshin]], nas Planícies Sagradas dos Kai. Você chega ao Mundo Sagrado dos Kai de [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Cápsula Espacial]] depois de completar a missão 23 da [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Saga Boo]].

10.source: Old Kai needs an [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]] of '''61 or higher''' (Good) for his '''Skills''', '''Train''' and new quests. His '''Unleash Power''' service asks for '''62 or higher'''.
10.translation: O Velho Kaioshin exige uma [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|índole]] de '''61 ou mais''' (boa) para as opções '''Habilidades''' e '''Treinar''' e as missões novas dele. O serviço '''Despertar poder''' pede '''62 ou mais'''.

12.source:
* '''Skills:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Infusion|Ki Infusion]], Healing Reduction
* '''Ki attack:''' Soul Punisher
12.translation:
* '''Habilidades:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Controle de Ki]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Infusion|Infusão de Ki]], Redução de Cura
* '''Ataque de ki:''' Castigador de Almas

13.source: Everything is paid for with Training Points, and your race has to allow each skill. His '''Train''' option spawns a Shadow Clone to spar with.
13.translation: Tudo é pago com pontos de treino, e sua raça precisa permitir cada habilidade. A opção '''Treinar''' dele invoca um Clone de Sombra para você lutar.

16.source: Below the required alignment or Potential Unlock level, the option stays locked and Old Kai tells you what's missing. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Minigames#Old Kai's Ultimate Challenge|Old Kai's Ultimate Challenge]] for the details.
16.translation: Abaixo da índole ou do nível de Potencial Liberado exigidos, a opção fica bloqueada e o Velho Kaioshin diz o que falta. Veja [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Minigames#Old Kai's Ultimate Challenge|O Desafio Ultimate do Velho Kaioshin]] para mais detalhes.

18.source:
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] quest 42, ''The Spirit Bomb Plan'': find Old Kai's Pillar and talk to Old Kai.
* Buu Saga quest 24, ''The Z Sword and Ultimate Power'': needs Potential Unlock 10, the Z Sword and the Ultimate skill, both from the Ultimate Challenge.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/GT Saga|GT Saga]] quest 18, ''The Elder Kai's Advice'': find Old Kai's Pillar and talk to Old Kai.
18.translation:
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Saga Boo]], missão 42, ''O Plano da Genki-Dama'': encontre o Pilar do Velho Kaioshin e fale com o Velho Kaioshin.
* Saga Boo, missão 24, ''A Espada Z e o Poder Ultimate'': exige Potencial Liberado 10, a Espada Z e a habilidade Ultimate, ambas do Desafio Ultimate.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/GT Saga|Saga GT]], missão 18, ''O Conselho do Velho Kaioshin'': encontre o Pilar do Velho Kaioshin e fale com o Velho Kaioshin.
